query_plan.query: Which Women's World cup had the most goals scored?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by world cup tournament, then find the one with the most goals scored.
steps.query: Return all Women's World cup tournaments and their goals scored.

extra.sql_query: SELECT tournaments.name FROM tournaments WHERE tournaments.name LIKE '%women%' AND tournaments.goals_scored = ( SELECT MAX(goals_scored) FROM tournaments WHERE tournaments.name LIKE '%women%' )

s1.sql_query: SELECT tournaments.name, tournaments.goals_scored FROM tournaments WHERE tournaments.name LIKE '%women%'
